name: Galrok the Burning

abilities.name: Fiery Surge
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals moderate flame damage and applies/refreshes "Scorch".

abilities.name: Flame Wave
abilities.description: Galrok does a cone fire breath attack dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Pillar Eruption
abilities.description: Galrok summons red spikes from the ground, indicated by red circles, each dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Pillar of Nirn
abilities.description: Standing in the circles from Pillar Eruption deals additional continuous moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Pillar Explosion
abilities.description: The spikes explode after a short while, dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Brimstone Hailfire
abilities.description: Galrok summons a large flaming pool at a target's location, indicated by a very large red circle, dealing continuous moderate flame damage and continuously snaring for 2 seconds targets inside. This ability also summons 3 Flame Hounds.

abilities.name: Ram
abilities.description: Galrok charges in a straight line, dealing moderate-high physical damage and knocking down targets hit. Blocking will negate the knockdown.

abilities.name: Molten Armor
abilities.description: Galrok covers itself in magical armor, granting itself a damage shield as well as increasing its outgoing damage for about 25 seconds.

summary: Galrok the Burning is a minotaur who serves as one of the champions of Silorn.
